title: Oura Ring stat statement
description: A centred proof statement on cream: a big, light editorial-serif claim on two lines with a tiny footnote mark, a tight 24px lede, a small note, a dark pill, then a wide product picture (contain) under it. The words fade in and rise 20px one after another; the picture comes in from a blur.
notes: the picture slot is 1248×644 (contain) on desktop; on phones it runs wider than the screen (140%) and is cropped at the sides, like the original
CSS scroll-driven reveals; static HTML and reduced motion show everything
name: ouraring-stats

props.name: title
props.description: the claim; a "\n" marks the desktop line break

props.name: footnote
props.description: a footnote mark after the claim, e.g. "1"

props.name: note
props.description: a small line under the lede, e.g. where the app runs

props.name: media
props.description: the wide picture under it (contain-fitted, e.g. a fan of app screens)
